micropython.override: Set MICROPYTHON_DIR to the extracted source directory

mpyCross.override: Set MPY_CROSS to the executable extracted from the verified wheel, or install mpy-cross==1.26.1.post2

wasiSdk.override: Set WASI_SDK_PATH to the extracted SDK directory

pluginSource.python: plugin.py is compiled by mpy-cross 1.26.1 to portable bytecode and executed by the official MicroPython 1.26.1 embedding runtime
pluginSource.nativeBoundary: guest.c contains Extism ABI bindings, a page-written/released Extism allocation probe, and MicroPython embedding bindings

upstreamConstraints: The official embed port is generated from pinned upstream source; the interpreter is not vendored.
WASI SDK supplies Clang and static libc for compilation, but the finished module is rejected if any WASI import survives dead-code elimination.
The 768 KiB interpreter heap is separate from the real Extism buffer used by the 16 MiB memory-limit probe; that probe does not claim a 16 MiB Python bytearray fits the fuel budget.
Binaryen spills local pointers to the C stack for conservative GC and emits standardized exception instructions; Extism's wasmtime-exceptions feature is required.
External imports, filesystem access, clock calls and stdout are unavailable; this is not CPython or arbitrary pip/C-extension compatibility.
